data.answer: Living in Eastern Residences Dubai promises an ideal blend of luxury and tranquility within the prestigious Falcon City of Wonders. The gated community will be equipped with exceptional amenities designed to elevate daily living, including shopping, medical, educational, and recreational facilities.

Eastern Residences Falcon City of Wonders will feature expansive 5 and 6-bedroom villas, each designed to embody luxurious living. The 5-bedroom villas offer 3,208 sq. ft. of space, while the 6-bedroom options provide an even more generous 4,580 sq. ft. 

These homes boast spacious back gardens, perfect for outdoor leisure and relaxation. Whether it's enjoying a lush private garden or the allure of an infinity pool, these villas offer residents a serene retreat. Each property also includes covered parking for three vehicles, ensuring both convenience and security.

Buying a Property in Eastern Residences

Looking for off-plan properties in Dubai? Investing in Falconcity of Wonders' upcoming sub-district, Eastern Residences, offers several attractive options. The 5 and 6-bedroom villas are available starting from AED 2.9 million.

For UAE nationals, the payment plan includes a zero down payment option, with up to 25 years to complete payments, making homeownership accessible. Non-UAE nationals can also take advantage of flexible payment terms, with a 10% down payment and customizable payment schedules to suit individual preferences.

data.content:
Nestled between Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311) and Sheikh Zayed Bin Hamdan Street (D54), Eastern Residences is a distinguished off-plan sub-community within the grand Falcon City of Wonders in Dubailand. 

Developed by Falcon City of Wonders, this gated community offers a serene sanctuary from the city's hustle while maintaining seamless connectivity to Dubai’s prime locations. The exclusive enclave features luxurious 5- and 6-bedroom villas, meticulously crafted to provide spacious and refined living environments. 

Residents can enjoy a wide selection of Eastern Residences amenities, including a supermarket, medical center, mosque, nursery, children’s playgrounds, and scenic communal parks. With its opulent villas, world-class amenities, and peaceful ambiance, Eastern Residences caters to discerning individuals who value both comfort and sophistication.
